Leads given: Raspberry Pi 45 W 1.5 m 17 AWG; Argon 27 W 1.5 m; TRASKIT 59 in; Vilros 27 W 5 ft (attached); CanaKit 3.5 A (Pi 4) 5 ft 18 AWG; Adafruit 5 V 4 A 1.5 m 20 AWG; iUniker 5.25 V 4 A 5 ft; XSL 27 W GaN (B0FHH9K47T) 120 cm 18 AWG; SunFounder 27 W 1.2 m; Orange Pi 5 V 4 A 1.2 m.

Supplies with leads of 8 ft or more: 5 V 1 to 2 A adapters for security cameras (USB-C or barrel), a 5 V 1.5 A 8 ft adapter, and JSAUX's 45 W Steam Deck charger (B0BHYN49SV), whose 10 ft cable is captive and whose 5 V profile is 3 A. Phone and laptop chargers sold with separate 10 or 15 ft cables offer 5 V at 3 A at most.
No Pi 5 supply had a USB-C socket for a cable of one's own. The 'with USB-C Charging Port' in Vilros's Amazon title refers to the devices it charges.
No listing that gives a lead length over 1.5 m gives a wire gauge.
